verdict.rationale: Admin controls for an organization's workspace are a fair question for an AI assistant like Copilot, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack covers only consumer Copilot. The only controls documented are per-user privacy settings (deleting conversation history, opting out of model training), which are adjacent individual controls rather than organizational member, permission, or data-policy management. No evidence shows an admin console, member management, or org-level policies.
